# AKS Security Advisories -- agent entrypoint (well-known path)

This is the RFC 8615 well-known location. The canonical agent entrypoint is one
directory up, at the site root:

    https://chrischangcode.github.io/aks-security-advisory/llms.txt

Read that file. It is intentionally the single prose copy: duplicating its text
here would let the two drift apart (this repo's tracked F8 defect: docs that
assert something the data no longer guarantees). The build-consistent, size-
bearing companion is generated with the feed at:

    https://chrischangcode.github.io/aks-security-advisory/data/llms.txt
